evidence: The ALE reaction chamber employed in the present work is a modified version of the rotating substrate approach described by Gons et al. This approach has been used to achieve the ALE growth of GaAs at a rate up to 2 mm/h. The reactor employs continuously flowing, yet spatially separate, gas streams, and a moving substrate to expose the wafer, (0001) sapphire, to alternating fluxes of Groups III and V reactants.
